name: Of One Mind (Teamwork)
body:
You and your allies keep each other apprised of danger.

Prerequisite(s): One other teamwork feat.

Benefit(s): You and all allies possessing this feat within 60 feet are equally aware of threats.

None of you are considered flanked .
